stations.title: Membership system
stations.text: Answers each search when it can.

stations.title: Your fix
stations.gap: The last answer to arrive wins

captions: Last, Imelda types "mar" to find Marnie, and the list shows everyone with an m.
The answer for "m" was slowest, so it came last, and the screen believed it.
You keep only the answers still wanted, for the search and the visits, in three tasks.
Whatever order the answers come in, "mar" shows Marnie.
Same system, same speed. Every answer still wanted shows the moment it comes.
